integrity: The infinite theorem is proved symbolically from exact crown neighborhoods. Exhaustive computation for \(3\le n\le8\) is used only as an independent finite check of the criterion, enumerator coefficients, minima, and counts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns balanced crown graphs and the k-tuple total restrained parameter only. It does not determine domatic, bondage, or upper-minimal variants. Originality remains subject to the residual risk of poorly indexed literature.
title: All \(k\)-tuple total restrained dominating sets of crown graphs
